titans.name: Male
titans.description: A colossal Earth Titan capable of both devastating attacks and locking down enemies underground. Eden's random crowd control makes battles unpredictable and hard to counter.

notable_counters.reason: Fire Titan especially effective against Eden. Araji's Incinerating Ray deals sustained ATK-scaling damage and Herald of Flame speeds up allies by 30%, countering Earth Titan compositions.

araji_skills.name: Incinerating Ray
araji_skills.description: Araji shoots out a stream of fire for 7.0 seconds, focusing it on the nearest enemy and dealing 1422 ATK damage per second.

araji_skills.name: Herald of Flame
araji_skills.description: Speeds up allies by 30% for 8.0 seconds.

skills.name: Basic Attack
skills.description: Deals physical damage to a single target.

skills.name: Burden of Creation
skills.description: Raises a humongous chunk of rock from the ground and hurls it at the center of the enemy team. All enemies next to the impact receive damage.

skills.name: Subterranean Prison
skills.description: Binds a random enemy with roots and pulls the victim under the ground for 6.0 seconds. Once the enemy is released, they stay stunned for 2 more seconds. If the target is the last enemy on the battlefield, they won't get pulled underground, but the stun effect will still affect them.
skills.note: Random targeting makes battles unpredictable — it is hard to define which enemy will be caught, which can greatly affect the outcome of battles.

artifacts.name: Earth Crown
artifacts.effect: Extra Damage to Water Titans +255000, Extra Defense from Water Titans +100500

best_team.name: Full Terra

members.name: Eden
members.note: Super Titan principal. Controla inimigos com Subterranean Prison e causa alto dano em área.

members.name: Verdoc
members.note: Principal responsável pelos buffs do time no ataque, principalmente contra times de Água. Peça central do meta Full Terra.

members.name: Avalon
members.note: Complementa a sinergia do time de Terra com escudo e cura.

members.name: Angus
members.note: Reforça a linha de frente do time de Terra com proteção adicional e capacidade de causar dano alto em área.

team_notes: Time full Terra atualmente no meta, especialmente forte no ataque.
Verdoc é o principal buffer do time e potencializa o dano de todos os membros.
Na defesa, adversários frequentemente utilizam Araji (Fire Titan) como counter a esta composição.

notes: Eden é um excelente super titan tanto na defesa quanto no ataque.
Sua habilidade Subterranean Prison é aleatória — enterrar um inimigo por 6s torna as batalhas muito imprevisíveis e dificulta definir quem será capturado.
No meta atual, times full Terra estão muito fortes, principalmente com os buffs de Verdoc no ataque.
Por esse motivo, muitos jogadores usam Araji na defesa como counter aos times de Terra.
